project_type: Discord.js v14 bot with TypeScript, SQLite (better-sqlite3), Express web dashboard
build_system: TypeScript compiler (tsc) + manual asset copy. Build script copies assets/, public/, creates data/ directory. Uses CommonJS modules.
test_framework: None - no test framework configured in package.json
test_command: None - testing must be done manually by running bot: npm start
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npm run build' to compile TypeScript. 2. Verify dist/ directory created with compiled JS. 3. Test locally with 'npm start'. 4. For database changes, test /daily and /balance commands. 5. For V2 changes, trigger V2 failures by testing commands in Railway environment. 6. Check console logs for errors.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ directory contains compiled JS from src/. Not checked in. Must rebuild after changes. data/ directory contains economy.db SQLite file - ephemeral on Railway.
environment_constraints: Railway uses ephemeral filesystem - any file-based SQLite DB at relative path (./data/economy.db) will lose data on redeploy. Railway redeploys on every push. Bot runs in production with real Discord users. Cannot restart dev server as there is none - this is production code. Database path must be configurable via DATABASE_PATH env var for Railway.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code patterns. Use Components V2 with smartReply fallback pattern. All database writes must use prepared statements with .run() and verify changes property. WAL mode enabled for better-sqlite3 concurrency.
key_patterns: 1. Modules use Components V2 (ContainerBuilder, TextDisplayBuilder) with MessageFlags.IsComponentsV2. 2. smartReply.ts exists but not widely adopted - provides auto-fallback from V2 to EmbedBuilder. 3. Database: better-sqlite3 with WAL mode, prepared statements. daily-module and balance-module share economy.db. 4. AI module uses Groq SDK and Google Gemini, with key rotation via aiKeyRotator.ts. 5. Errors logged to console with emoji prefixes (✅, ❌, ⚠️). 6. Commands use SlashCommandBuilder, interactions deferred immediately with try-catch for 10062/40060 errors.
directory_structure: src/modules/ contains all feature modules (ai-module/, daily-module/, balance-module/, music-module/, utility/, etc.), each with entry_point.ts and metadata.json. src/database/ contains database init. src/utils/ contains shared helpers (smartReply.ts, aiKeyRotator.ts, v2Helper.ts). dist/ is output directory. data/ contains SQLite database files.
